operating_notes.text: Garment sales volume reached 181.45 million units in FY26.
Ethanol sales volume reached 760.73 lakh litres in FY26.
Yarn and fabric sales volume was 18,142 MT in Q1FY27 against 17,539 MT a year earlier, with sales value of ₹541 Cr.
Garment sales value rose to ₹962 Cr in Q1FY27 from ₹895 Cr a year earlier even as volume fell to 49.50 million pieces from 50.04 million.
North America was 58.2% of exports in Q1FY27, down from 64.9% in FY23, while Europe rose to 21.0%.

predictions.kpi: EBITDA margin holding near 20% as new capacity is built

timeline.summary: K.P.R. Developers Limited, as part of K.P.R. Mill Limited’s promoter group, declares no encumbrance on 49,71,308 shares as of March 31, 2026.
K.R. Parvathi, as part of the promoter group, declared no encumbrance on 84,34,659 equity shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
K.P.R. Mill Limited’s Board recommended **250% final dividend (₹2.50/share)** for FY 2025-26 on May 12, 2026, pending shareholder approval.
K.P.R. Mill reported Q4FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹227.17 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹2.50/share.
P. Nataraj, Managing Director, declared that he and persons acting in concert have not made any encumbrance on the company's shares as of 31 March 2026.
